title: Rural Home Loans Note Rate at Closing and the Closing Discounts
content:
**Rule.** The note rate of a Rural Home Loans product at closing is the product's initial rate less the autopay discount when automatic debit is authorised at closing, and less the relationship discount when the member holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status on the closing date (at least one of the member's Farm Real Estate Loans in active status); the discounts are added and capped at the product's discount cap, and the rate is rounded to 3 decimal places. The monthly payment is the level payment amortising original principal over the product's amortization months at the note rate, rounded to cents. If automatic debit set up at closing is later cancelled, the autopay discount is removed: the note rate rises by the autopay discount from the next payment due date and the payment is re-amortised over the remaining months. Enrolling in automatic debit after closing, or moving it to another account, never lowers the rate. The relationship discount is fixed at closing.

## The rate as a definition

The note rate at closing is the initial rate less the smaller of (a) the discount cap and (b) the total of the autopay discount, where automatic debit is authorised at closing, and the relationship discount, where the member holds an active Farm Real Estate loan on the closing date; that difference is rounded to 3 decimal places.

## Truth table of the closing discounts

| Automatic debit authorised at closing | Active Farm Real Estate loan on closing date | Discount taken |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | autopay plus relationship, no more than the cap |
| yes | no | autopay discount, no more than the cap |
| no | yes | relationship discount, no more than the cap |
| no | no | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- An initial rate of 6.375 with an autopay discount of 0.125, a relationship discount of 0.125 and a cap of 0.25, both discounts earned: the discounts total 0.25, the cap is 0.25, so 0.25 is taken and the note rate is 6.125.
- An initial rate of 6.625 with an autopay discount of 0.125, a relationship discount of 0.0 and a cap of 0.125, both conditions met: the discounts total 0.125, within the cap, and the note rate is 6.5.

## After closing

| Event | Effect on the note rate |
|---|---|
| Automatic debit set up at closing is cancelled | rises by the autopay discount from the next payment due date; payment re-amortised over the remaining months |
| Automatic debit moved to another account | none |
| Automatic debit first enrolled after closing | never lowers the rate |
| Farm Real Estate loan opened or closed after closing | none; the relationship discount is fixed at closing |
